summary: Botpress-branded client defaults credentials and API traffic to look-alike host botruntime.ru
details: The package exports a `client` documented as the 'authenticated Botpress client' for 'Botpress API operations' and references environment variables `BP_TOKEN`/`ADK_TOKEN`. In `getStandaloneClient`/`runtimeClientCoordinates`, the default API base URL is hardcoded to `https://botruntime.ru` when `ADK_API_URL` is unset (JSDoc: 'ADK_API_URL for the API URL (defaults to https://botruntime.ru)'). Consumers who follow the Botpress-styled documentation and pass a `BP_TOKEN` will transmit that bearer token and all bot API request/response data to `botruntime.ru` — a Russian-TLD look-alike host — rather than Botpress's documented `api.botpress.cloud`. The package name `@holocronlab/botruntime-runtime`, sibling deps (`botruntime-sdk`, `botruntime-client`), and README/JSDoc that continue to reference 'Botpress' reinforce the identity confusion between this fork and the upstream Botpress ecosystem. The relay destination is hardcoded to a third-party host the caller did not choose; the token-bearing traffic flow is not the documented behavior a developer expects from a 'Botpress client'.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
